label: 超宽膝正面跪姿
pose_lead: Grounded pose, frontal kneel with the knees ultra-wide:
lower_limbs: Both knees open to the sides at their widest, the lower legs folded back or inward, the pelvis sitting low.
upper_limbs: Both arms hang vertically, the hands stacked or side by side on the ground directly in front.
torso_head: The upper body upright with a slight forward lean, the shoulders centered, the head frontal.
weight_silhouette: Like the frontal wide kneel but wider and lower, the horizontal outline even more emphatic.
